column1: Number of Completed Credible Fear Screenings
1 The number of Credible Fear Screenings completed during the reporting period.
2 The number of Credible Fear Screenings with a positive determination (Fear Established) during the reporting period.
3 The number of Credible Fear Screenings with a negative determination (Fear Not Established) during the reporting period.
4 The number of Credible Fear Screenings USCIS administratively closed during the reporting period.
5 The number of Credible Fear Screenings with a positive fear determination based on persecution during the reporting period.
6 The number of Credible Fear Screenings with a positive fear determination based on torture during the reporting period.
7 The number of Credible Fear Screenings USCIS administratively closed because the individual withdrew his/her fear claim.
8The number of of Credible Fear Screenings USCIS administratively closed for various reasons such as non-citizen in State or Federal custody, unable to effectively communicate, ineligible, etc.
9 The number of Credible Fear screenings USCIS administratively closed because USCIS was unable to provide an interpreter speaking the individual's preferred language.
1) Screenings completed or pending a decision may have been received in previous reporting periods.
2) Screening receipts and outcomes include one individual.
3) The report reflects the most up-to-date summary statistics available at the time the database is queried.
4) Counts may differ from previous periods due to system updates and post-adjudicative outcomes.
5) For a complete list of USCIS forms and descriptions, visit: https://www.uscis.gov/forms
